notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.113

Fewer QuickBooks connections: all the bank accounts are now read together, in three QuickBooks connections in total (registers, deposits and sales receipts) however many accounts there are. Before, it was about three connections per account, and each one takes a few seconds while the helper connects and signs in to the company file.
Ready before you open it: after each sync from QuickBooks, this month and last month are read in the background, so the report opens straight away.
The report shows when it was read and has a Read again from QuickBooks button.
It’s prepared at most once an hour, and not for a month that’s already finalised.
A prepared copy is used for up to 3 hours. If you open the report while it’s being prepared, it waits for that to finish.
